items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: There was a fellow by the name of Son Thomas was playing banjo with him.

ctx.x: And let's see, who else would be in the band? Drums and banjo I guess maybe.
There was a fellow by the name of Son Thomas was playing banjo with him. He has passed too. I just remember the drummer.
And let's see, after Howard you went with Henry Allen. Went with Henry Allen. That's the young son. The young son, yeah.
